vignette: A resident cares for several patients with different special health care needs and asks whether the oral findings seen in one group can be assumed to apply to all of them.
stem: Which statement most accurately describes oral manifestations in people with special health care needs?

options.text: They differ in cause, how often they occur, and how severe they are.
They are identical in cause and severity across all special health care needs.
They occur at the same frequency in every special health care need.
They differ in severity but always share one cause.
